longBusinessSummary: iA Financial Corporation Inc., provides insurance and wealth management services for individual and group basis in Canada and the United States. It operates through Insurance, Canada; Wealth Management; US Operations; and Investment segments. The company offers life, health, auto, home, and creditor insurance products; replacement insurance products and warranties; extended warranties and other ancillary products for dealer services; and specialized products for special markets; and life insurance products and extended warranties relating to dealer services. It also provides savings plans, retirement, and segregated funds, securities brokerage, trust operations, and mutual funds.
